self_roast.question: If deterministic_ci_artifact's PASS rests on 429/429 tests + 3 verify scripts + 59/59 RC, could the contract be silently violated while tests still green?
self_roast.answer: Not for the authored AC surface. Every PRD AC is enumerated 1:1 in test_contract.json (grep_count or test_exit_code binding). Develop's truth machine already PASS-verified 59/59 RC on these bindings with deterministic_parser backing in evidence/evidence.jsonl. CI re-ran the same bindings on the merge HEAD (6d9b918). A silent disable would have lit up evidence_validate.py and refused the develop terminal. The legitimate residual risk is runtime/render correctness on the deployed tenant content domain — covered separately by the deferred production smoke obligation (production_deploy_status=PENDING_USER_WORKFLOW_DISPATCH).
self_roast.finding: Verdict is sound for the authored AC set. Runtime/render correctness on production tenant content domain is a DEFERRED check (operator-triggered deploy + post-deploy smoke), not a missed check.
self_roast.action_taken: Surfaced production deploy command in finish telemetry and reviewer_finding.json. No MQAFIX created; mainGoal has no runtime metric.

self_roast.question: T16 says cms.kodigital.app GET / -> 404 no leak — is that verified at PRODUCTION, or only at unit-test level?
self_roast.answer: Verified at UNIT-TEST level only. T16 is implemented as test/public-admin-host-no-home.test.ts (vitest with Miniflare) — proves the worker code returns 404 for Host=cms.kodigital.app on the squash-merged HEAD before any deploy. PRODUCTION verification would require: (a) operator triggers gh workflow run deploy.yml + (b) curl -H 'Host: cms.kodigital.app' https://cms.kodigital.app/ — but the route is CF Access protected so anonymous curl will redirect to login, NOT return the worker's 404. The clean production smoke is: post-deploy, query a tenant content domain that IS configured to route through the worker, expect 200 + site-header in body.
self_roast.finding: T16 unit coverage is solid; production smoke requires CF Access auth OR a tenant domain.
self_roast.action_taken: Smoke obligation documented as P2 advisory in reviewer_finding.json + finish telemetry.

self_roast.question: manualQA.md authored ZERO browser scenarios — does that mean the plan was bad, or that browser QA is genuinely not the right modality for this mission?
self_roast.answer: The latter. The mission's deliverable is server-side HTML rendering with a deterministic test contract (test_contract.json maps every AC to a grep / test_exit_code / test_name_regex). vitest tests render the templates with Miniflare + assert markup in-process, which is structurally stronger than browser smoke for THIS scope (server templates with no interactive client behavior beyond passive listeners). The plan correctly omitted browser scenarios; the test_contract bindings are the full evidence surface. If future stories add interactive UI (e.g., a custom newsletter widget that POSTs), browser scenarios become necessary.
self_roast.finding: Plan authoring is consistent with the scope; not a planning gap.
self_roast.action_taken: No corrective action needed. Route correctly set to deterministic_ci_artifact.
